question: Who among the following was an exponent of classical Carnatic music?
solution:
The correct answer is **Dr. Balamuralikrishna**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dr. Balamuralikrishna** was a renowned exponent of classical Carnatic music.
 
• He was known for his versatile singing and mastery over multiple musical instruments.
 
• He contributed significantly to the field of Carnatic music with numerous compositions.
 
• He received several prestigious awards including the Padma Vibhushan and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.<
